_comment: Every path this site serves outside `/`, the one place a new section is registered. scripts/emit-headers.mjs turns it into dist/_headers rules and apps/worker/vite.config.ts into the :5173 dev proxy; verify-build.mjs fails a built page that is missing here. `pages` are exact, `trees` cover `/x/*` (a hub at `/x` goes in `pages` too), `documents` map a file to its Content-Type, `uncached` is served with no Cache-Control on purpose.
